name: saucedemo-reqres-automation
description: UI automation (Playwright + TypeScript) for saucedemo.com and API automation (Postman/Newman) for reqres.in

scripts.ui:q1: npm run clean && playwright test tests/ui/q1-locked-out-user.spec.ts
scripts.report:allure: allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report && allure open allure-report
scripts.api:q3: newman run api/reqres.postman_collection.json -e api/reqres.postman_environment.json --folder "API-Q3 Login" -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/api/api-q3-login.html
scripts.api:q4: newman run api/reqres.postman_collection.json -e api/reqres.postman_environment.json --folder "API-Q4 Get User" -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/api/api-q4-get-user.html
scripts.api:q5: newman run api/reqres.postman_collection.json -e api/reqres.postman_environment.json --folder "API-Q5 PUT Profile" -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/api/api-q5-put.html
scripts.api:q6: newman run api/reqres.postman_collection.json -e api/reqres.postman_environment.json --folder "API-Q6 PATCH Field" -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/api/api-q6-patch.html
scripts.api:q8: newman run api/reqres.postman_collection.json -e api/reqres.postman_environment.json --folder "API-Q8 Bad Requests" -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/api/api-q8-bad-requests.html
scripts.api:all: newman run api/reqres.postman_collection.json -e api/reqres.postman_environment.json -r cli,htmlextra,junit --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/api/api-all.html --reporter-junit-export reports/api/api-all.xml
scripts.test:all: npm run ui:all && npm run api:all
